I am growing cassava and sweet potato on this small piece of land near my home. Fertilizer from the shop is too expensive for me this year, and tubers do not need it as much as maize does, so I will just put the manure from my goats and chickens on the plot before planting. I keep my own cuttings and vines from last season, so I do not need to buy seed. My children and I will do the weeding and harvesting ourselves; I cannot afford to hire people for such a small garden.
